verdict.rationale: Entra ID documents Lifecycle Workflows that manage users across the three phases of their lifecycle and run processes automatically. Its automatic provisioning into SaaS apps such as Dropbox, Salesforce and ServiceNow covers part of the app-by-app work. The evidence does not show that workflows are no-code, which events trigger them, or that they coordinate per-app actions on role change and departure. missing for 10: explicit no-code workflow builder evidence, documented hire/role-change/departure trigger events, evidence that workflows orchestrate per-app deprovisioning and changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, identity events trigger automation — no-code workflows on hire, role change, and departure handle the app-by-app choreography for me

citations.quote: Lifecycle workflows (LCW) are identity governance capabilities that enable organizations to manage Microsoft Entra users across the three phases of a user's lifecycle with an organization
Workflows contain specific processes that run automatically against users as they move through their lifecycle.
Common scenarios include provisioning a Microsoft Entra user into SaaS applications like Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and many more.
